hook: Say any word 30 times. Something strange happens.
facts: Say *'door'* out loud again and again.
Soon it stops sounding like a word. It becomes odd *noise*.
It's called *semantic satiation*, and researchers have studied it since the *1900s*.
Your brain briefly tires of the word's *meaning*, not the sound.
outro: Try it. Say it thirty times.
title: Psychology Facts
